app.name: LexBridge
app.description: Modular legal workflow support for Swiss corporate matters.

dashboard.title: Legal Workspace
dashboard.description: Access your legal workflows and prepare preliminary corporate documents.
dashboard.corporateDescription: Prepare Swiss corporate registry checklists and document drafts.
dashboard.moreModulesDescription: Contracts and Compliance are planned for future releases.
dashboard.disclaimer: LexBridge supports preliminary legal workflows. All outputs require human review.

corporate.title: Corporate Governance
corporate.description: Prepare a corporate registry workflow, review legal steps and generate document drafts.
corporate.matterDescription: Enter the company information step by step.
corporate.matterEditDescription: You can edit case information without losing compatible review progress.
corporate.reviewDescription: Review the workflow, legal considerations, official sources and available documents.
corporate.confirmDescription: Please review the information before generating the legal workflow.
corporate.noChanges: No changes detected. Existing review retained.

workflow.checklistDescription: Track the review status of each step. Completing a step is not legal approval.
workflow.reviewNeedsChecking: Previously reviewed steps must be checked against the updated information.
workflow.disclaimer: Preliminary rule-based legal workflow. Human review is required before any filing.

legal.warningsIntroduction: Review the following considerations before preparing or filing documents.
legal.noWarnings: No additional warnings are recorded. Human legal review is still required.
legal.sourcesIntroduction: The following sources are provided for manual verification. LexBridge does not automatically confirm that a legal source is current or applicable.
legal.notLegalAdvice: This output does not constitute legal advice.
legal.verifyCurrentLaw: Verify the current law and applicable registry requirements.

documents.title: Document Generator
documents.description: Prepare a preliminary mandate acceptance declaration in French or German.
documents.allFieldsPresent: All declared template fields are present. This does not confirm legal completeness.
documents.noDocuments: No document templates are available for this operation.
documents.disclaimer: Draft document only. Review the content and applicable signature requirements before use.
documents.generated: Document draft generated. Human review required.
documents.generatedIncomplete: Document draft generated with missing information.

validation.completeStep: Please complete the required information before continuing.
validation.confirmScopeChange: The company type, canton or operation has changed. A new legal workflow is required, and previous checklist statuses cannot automatically be reused.

status.workflowReady: Corporate workflow generated. You can now review each section.
status.updateFailed: Workflow update failed. The previous report has been retained.
status.usingFallback: Workspace unavailable. Using the original interface.

language.languageError: Unable to change the interface language.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.localProcessing: Documents are processed locally in your browser using the current rule-based workflow.
privacy.noServerStorage: LexBridge does not currently provide server-side case storage.
privacy.sessionWarning: Unsaved case information may be lost when you refresh or close the page.
privacy.confidentiality: Avoid using confidential client information in the public demonstration.

errors.title: LexBridge — Error Monitor
errors.description: An error occurred while loading or running the application.
errors.checkMonitor: Check the LexBridge Error Monitor for details.
